node.criteria: Pass if the overall visible result reads as a pencil drawing of the content. Unknown if the overall rendering cannot be assessed reliably. Judge the result as presented; do not require monochrome, particular marks, or a specific transformation method, and do not treat muted color or grain alone as decisive.
